positions.title: Computer Vision Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for designing and implementing software solutions for multiple TARGAN products, including WingScan and the Vaccine Delivery System. Focused primarily on software systems designed to be deployed onto NVIDIA Jetson edge devices using Docker containers.

Used open-source libraries such as GStreamer and NVIDIA Deepstream to perform real-time inference on video using object detection neural networks. Used proprietary training data to perform fine-tuning on off-the-shelf models including YOLOv5.

Used OpenCV to implement a fast and robust system for triangulating objects in a multi-camera system with arbitrary geometry, with sub-millimeter precision. Designed and implemented a system for performing highly accurate camera calibration in the field.

Responsible for debugging, profiling, and analyzing complex software systems. Used Cython to bridge the gap between legacy Python code and performance-critical C/C++ functions. Leveraged parallel processing to implement a logging system capable of storing large amounts of tabular and image data with minimal overhead. Wrote developer tools designed to analyze test results and diagnose failures.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), NVIDIA Jetson and +4 skills

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Responsible for contributing to the development of deep learning systems to support testing of TARGAN's automatic poultry vaccination systems.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Computer Vision and +3 skills

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Wrote and maintained python code to interpret, use, and store visual motion capture data. Wrote code to calculate the location of joint centers, given visual motion capture data from both sides of a joint. Helped write a published paper describing the design and use of the resulting software package.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Motion Capture and +2 skills

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Used deep learning to develop a tool to calculate the location of a joint center from motion capture data, with the desired result being a tool which requires less data and works faster than currently existing joint center calculation methods.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Motion Capture and +2 skills

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Worked as part of an interdisciplinary team of 24 high school, undergraduate and graduate students integrating various engineering and programming systems for the Duke University Ocean XPRIZE project (a global competition challenging teams to advance deep-sea technologies for autonomous, fast, and high-resolution ocean exploration).
 - Responsible for programming, testing, and improving an autonomous flight system that instructs a drone to survey the ocean floor by delivering and retrieving sonar pods to and from precise GPS coordinates.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Refurbished old computers for donation to families who could not afford computers of their own. 
 - Helped scrap computers that could not be refurbished. The parts from these computers were recycled or sold to benefit the charity. 
 - Learned to safely disassemble computers and to diagnose common hardware-related issues.
